mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, locker_number, locker_type FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} ORDER BY locker_number
SELECT NVL(MAX(locker_number), 0) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNTACT_BOOK_LOCKER_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND locker_type = '도서대출'
SELECT homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count FROM UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO UNTACT_BOOK_SETTING a USING dual ON (a.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.locker_use_yn = #{locker_use_yn}, a.row_count = #{row_count}, a.total_count = #{total_count} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( homepage_id, locker_use_yn, row_count, total_count ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{locker_use_yn}, #{row_count}, #{total_count} )
